required_evidence: Construct the maximal lower semicontinuous convex minorant from finite-observation records.
Justify the affine dual formula and monotonic compatibility under enlarging F.
Handle extended values and infima without assuming optimizers exist.
critical_errors: Use convexity alone to identify f with its biconjugate.
Treat lower semicontinuous relaxation as equality with all original boundary values.
Assert minimizers or finite-observation fiber optimizers exist without proof.
Upgrade monotone compatibility to unproved commutation with closed projections.
completion_policy: Prove the stated weak construction and its actual universal/limit properties. Do not require optional strengthenings or author counterexamples if no false strengthening is asserted.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions; silently promoting their scope is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
